scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names contracts,web,desktop "pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build --watch" "pnpm --filter @velin/web dev" "pnpm --filter @velin/desktop dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build && pnpm --filter @velin/web build && pnpm --filter @velin/desktop build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build && pnpm --filter @velin/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @velin/desktop typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @velin/contracts build && pnpm --filter @velin/contracts test && pnpm --filter @velin/ui test && pnpm --filter @velin/desktop test && pnpm --filter @velin/web test
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages docs AGENTS.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages docs AGENTS.md README.md
